The office of the Minister for Communications today released the following statement: “Although we have ceased construction we are not scraping the data center, merely putting a pause on development until further assessment.”

Though the Minister’s office would not comment on what prompted this, speculation has come from sources within the SENT base in Auckland, citing underfunding as the most likely reason for the halt. One worker reported “things have been going sour between the local SENT team and the NZ government for a while now.
